metric_comparability_rules.target_metric: U.S. Headline CPI YoY (Year-over-Year Percentage Change)
prohibited_comparisons: Core CPI (excluding Food and Energy) vs Headline CPI

causality_law.anti_lookahead_rule: Consensus published or observed on or after release is rejected as VINTAGE_VIOLATION
causality_law.revision_handling: Later-revised consensus values cannot be substituted for contemporaneous forecasts

current_pilot_status.pilot_impact: Descriptive market observations (returns, realized volatility, spread) will proceed normally. Economic surprise calculations and surprise-conditioned conclusions are explicitly DISABLED.
